```{r setup, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({

  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

```{r paths}
WORK_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Updated"

PLOT_DIR   <- file.path(WORK_DIR, "plots")
```

# Read log2TPM expression matrix

```{r read-expression}
expr_dt <- fread(log2tpm_file)

dim(expr_dt)
head(expr_dt[, 1:5])
```

```{r build-expression-matrix}
gene_col <- colnames(expr_dt)[1]

gene_ids <- as.character(expr_dt[[gene_col]])

expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_dt[, -1, with = FALSE])
mode(expr_mat) <- "numeric"

rownames(expr_mat) <- gene_ids

dim(expr_mat)
head(rownames(expr_mat), 20)
```

# Clean expression matrix

```{r clean-expression}
expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  !is.na(rownames(expr_mat_annot)) &
    rownames(expr_mat_annot) != "",
]

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  rowSums(is.finite(expr_mat_annot)) == ncol(expr_mat_annot),
]

dim(expr_mat_annot)
```

# Remove duplicated gene symbols

If duplicated gene symbols exist, keep the gene row with the highest mean expression.

```{r remove-duplicates}
gene_mean <- rowMeans(expr_mat_annot, na.rm = TRUE)

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[
  order(rownames(expr_mat_annot), -gene_mean),
]

expr_mat_annot <- expr_mat_annot[!duplicated(rownames(expr_mat_annot)), ]

dim(expr_mat_annot)
head(rownames(expr_mat_annot))
```

# 9. Save cleaned gene-symbol log2TPM matrix

```{r save-cleaned-expression}
clean_expr_file <- file.path(

fwrite(

    gene_symbol = rownames(expr_mat_annot),
    expr_mat_annot
  ),
  clean_expr_file,
  sep = "\t"
)

clean_expr_file
```

# Load KEGG pathway gene sets

```{r load-kegg}
get_kegg_sets <- function() {
  kegg_sets <- tryCatch(
    {
      msigdbr(
        species = "Homo sapiens",
        collection = "C2",
        subcollection = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("Trying older msigdbr syntax...")
      msigdbr(
        species = "Homo sapiens",
        category = "C2",
        subcategory = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"
      )
    }
  )
  
  return(kegg_sets)
}

kegg_sets <- get_kegg_sets()

dim(kegg_sets)
head(kegg_sets)
```

# Create KEGG pathway list.

```{r create-kegg-list}
kegg_pathways <- split(
  kegg_sets$gene_symbol,
  kegg_sets$gs_name
)

kegg_pathways <- lapply(kegg_pathways, unique)

length(kegg_pathways)
head(names(kegg_pathways))
```

# Check overlap between RNA-seq genes and KEGG genes

```{r gene-overlap}
all_kegg_genes <- unique(unlist(kegg_pathways))

overlap_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(expr_mat_annot),
  all_kegg_genes
)

length(overlap_genes)
length(overlap_genes) / length(all_kegg_genes)

head(overlap_genes, 20)
```
# Run KEGG ssGSEA using GSVA

This produces a pathway-by-sample matrix.

Rows = KEGG pathways
Columns = pILC samples
Values = ssGSEA pathway activity scores

```{r run-ssgsea}
run_ssgsea <- function(expr_mat, pathway_list) {
  
  if ("ssgseaParam" %in% getNamespaceExports("GSVA")) {
    
    message("Using newer GSVA syntax with ssgseaParam()")
    
    ssgsea_param <- ssgseaParam(
      exprData = expr_mat,
      geneSets = pathway_list,
      minSize = 10,
      maxSize = 500
    )
    
    scores <- gsva(ssgsea_param)
    
  } else {
    
    message("Using older GSVA syntax")
    
    scores <- gsva(
      expr = expr_mat,
      gset.idx.list = pathway_list,
      method = "ssgsea",
      min.sz = 10,
      max.sz = 500,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  }
  
  return(scores)
}

kegg_ssgsea_scores <- run_ssgsea(
  expr_mat = expr_mat_annot,
  pathway_list = kegg_pathways
)

dim(kegg_ssgsea_scores)
kegg_ssgsea_scores[1:5, 1:5]
```

# Identify most variable KEGG pathways across pILC samples

Because all samples are pILC, the key question is not differential enrichment between groups. Instead, the useful question is:

```text
Which KEGG pathways show the most heterogeneity across pILC samples?
```

```{r pathway-variability}
pathway_var <- apply(
  kegg_ssgsea_scores,
  1,
  var,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pathway_mean <- rowMeans(
  kegg_ssgsea_scores,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pathway_var_df <- data.frame(
  pathway = names(pathway_var),
  variance = as.numeric(pathway_var),
  mean_score = as.numeric(pathway_mean),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

pathway_var_df <- pathway_var_df[
  order(-pathway_var_df$variance),
]

head(pathway_var_df, 30)
```

Save pathway variability table.

```{r save-pathway-variability}
pathway_var_out <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "pILC_KEGG_ssGSEA_pathway_variability.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  pathway_var_df,
  pathway_var_out,
  sep = "\t"
)

pathway_var_out
```

# Plot top 20 variable KEGG pathways

```{r heatmap-top20, fig.width=10, fig.height=8}
top_n <- 20

top_variable_pathways <- pathway_var_df$pathway[1:top_n]

mat_top <- kegg_ssgsea_scores[
  top_variable_pathways,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

mat_top_z <- t(scale(t(mat_top)))

rownames(mat_top_z) <- gsub("^KEGG_", "", rownames(mat_top_z))
rownames(mat_top_z) <- gsub("^KEGG_LEGACY_", "", rownames(mat_top_z))
rownames(mat_top_z) <- gsub("_", " ", rownames(mat_top_z))

pheatmap(
  mat_top_z,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  main = "Top variable KEGG pathway activity across pILC samples"
)
```

Save heatmap as PDF.

```{r save-heatmap-pdf}
heatmap_file <- file.path(
  PLOT_DIR,
  "Top20_variable_KEGG_ssGSEA_heatmap.pdf"
)

pdf(heatmap_file, width = 10, height = 8)

pheatmap(
  mat_top_z,
  clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
  clustering_distance_cols = "correlation",
  clustering_method = "complete",
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  main = "Top variable KEGG pathway activity across pILC samples"
)

dev.off()

heatmap_file
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify commonly enriched KEGG pathways across pILC samples
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# For each sample, define "high pathway activity" as top 25% of ssGSEA scores
top_fraction <- 0.25

high_pathway_mat <- apply(
  kegg_ssgsea_scores,
  2,
  function(x) {
    cutoff <- quantile(x, probs = 1 - top_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)
    x >= cutoff
  }
)

# Convert to matrix and preserve pathway/sample names
high_pathway_mat <- as.matrix(high_pathway_mat)
rownames(high_pathway_mat) <- rownames(kegg_ssgsea_scores)
colnames(high_pathway_mat) <- colnames(kegg_ssgsea_scores)

# Count in how many samples each pathway is high
common_pathway_df <- data.frame(
  pathway = rownames(kegg_ssgsea_scores),
  n_samples_high = rowSums(high_pathway_mat),
  percent_samples_high = rowSums(high_pathway_mat) / ncol(kegg_ssgsea_scores) * 100,
  mean_score = rowMeans(kegg_ssgsea_scores, na.rm = TRUE),
  median_score = apply(kegg_ssgsea_scores, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

common_pathway_df <- common_pathway_df[
  order(
    -common_pathway_df$n_samples_high,
    -common_pathway_df$median_score
  ),
]

head(common_pathway_df, 20)
```
```{r}
common_pathway_out <- file.path(
  RESULT_DIR,
  "pILC_common_enriched_KEGG_pathways.tsv"
)

fwrite(
  common_pathway_df,
  common_pathway_out,
  sep = "\t"
)

common_pathway_out
```

```{r}
top_common_df$pathway_clean <- gsub("^KEGG_", "", top_common_df$pathway_clean)
top_common_df$pathway_clean <- gsub("_", " ", top_common_df$pathway_clean)

top_common_df$pathway_clean <- factor(
```
